gloss: to forbid; to prohibit; to suppress

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {禁|きん}ずていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to forbid; to prohibit; to ban
definitions.explanation: To officially or authoritatively prohibit an action or behavior.

definitions.gloss: to suppress; to hold back (a feeling)
definitions.explanation: To restrain oneself from expressing an emotion, especially in expressions meaning unable to hold back tears or unable to suppress a feeling.

examples.japanese: {喫煙|きつえん}を{禁|きん}ずる。
{法律|ほうりつ}で{禁|きん}じられている。
この{区域|くいき}では{釣|つ}りが{禁|きん}じられている。
examples.english: Fishing is prohibited in this area.

examples.japanese: {涙|なみだ}を{禁|きん}じえなかった。
examples.english: I couldn't hold back my tears.

examples.japanese: {驚|おどろ}きを{禁|きん}じえない。
その{知|し}らせを{聞|き}いて、{悲|かな}しみを{禁|きん}じえなかった。
examples.english: Upon hearing the news, I couldn't suppress my sadness.

notes:
A ずる verb (literary ichidan form of {禁|きん}じる). Both {禁|きん}ずる and {禁|きん}じる are used, with {禁|きん}じる being more common in modern Japanese. The ずる form appears in signs, formal writing, and set phrases.

KEY EXPRESSION:
{禁|きん}じえない (unable to suppress/hold back) is a very common literary expression used with emotions: {涙|なみだ}を{禁|きん}じえない (unable to hold back tears), {驚|おどろ}きを{禁|きん}じえない (unable to suppress one's astonishment).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {喫煙|きつえん}を{禁|きん}ずる — to prohibit smoking
- {法律|ほうりつ}で{禁|きん}じる — to prohibit by law
- {涙|なみだ}を{禁|きん}じえない — unable to hold back tears
- {驚|おどろ}きを{禁|きん}じえない — unable to suppress astonishment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {禁止|きんし}する — to prohibit; the most common modern way to express prohibition, while {禁|きん}ずる is more literary
- {制限|せいげん}する — to restrict; implies limiting rather than completely banning
